code.note: Host: the stock rev limiter with its two cut/resume loads rewritten into jumps to the detour.

accepted.why: Delay slot of jmp @r0 at 0x03B6B0. Its r2 is dead: the detour reloads r2 at 0x0F1030 before reading it. The same word runs again, outside any slot, when the detour returns here.
Delay slot of jmp @r0 at 0x03B6BA. Its r2 is dead for the same reason; the detour always returns to 0x03B6B2, never here.

code.note: Adds an offset to fr15 (rpm) when vehicle speed is low; host saves/restores fr15, so the change does not leak past the host's return. fr9 is never read by the host; fr6, fr8, r0 and r2 are reloaded before use.

review_questions: The fr15 offset also reaches the comparisons at 0x03B6DA and 0x03B6EA (thresholds from 0x03B7B0 / 0x03B7B4), which set byte +2 of the flag block at 0x03B7AC. Is that intended, and what do those thresholds gate?
